title: Path of Exile 2 0.3.0 — The Third Edict: Act 4, Cruel Removal, Support Gem Overhaul & Why Old Guides Broke
summary: 0.3.0 added Act 4, removed Cruel Difficulty, inserted three Interludes to Level 65, launched Rise of the Abyssals, and overhauled Support Gems by removing the one-per-character limit. This page explains what changed and what old攻略 still applies.
description: A returning-player history of 0.3.0 The Third Edict: campaign restructure, Support Gem overhaul, Rise of the Abyssals, massive character balance, and Essence/Atlas/Endgame/Item/Skill changes — with a 0.5.4e applicability board.
author: StratLore Editorial
imageAlt: Path of Exile 2 Chronomancer casting a cold spell

sections.title: Quick summary
paragraphs: Content update 0.3.0 the third edict was the campaign and systems overhaul that most older guides warn about it added act 4 removed cruel difficulty inserted three temporary interludes that push characters to level 65 and launched rise of the abyssals

Its single most disruptive mechanic change was the support gem overhaul the rule that one support could only be used once per character was removed supports could be repeated multiple supports gained tiers and eleven new supports were added
bullets: Rise of the abyssals league launched
Support gem overhaul removed one per character limit
Large character balance essence atlas endgame item skill changes

sections.title: Historical context
sections.era: Path of Exile 2 Early Access — 0.3.0 (The Third Edict)
sections.baselineNote: All 'current' statements below are measured against client 0.5.4e.
paragraphs: Before 0.3.0 the campaign ended differently and support gems were scarcer per character the third edict flattened that scarcity and re structured the end of the story
0.3.1 covered separately later reworked the endgame tablet system so some endgame claims here were refined again after 0.3.0
bullets: 0.3.1 endgame tablet rework see separate page

cards.detail: Act 4 added, Cruel removed, three Interludes to L65. Old 'Acts 1-3 then Cruel' flow is gone.
One-per-character limit removed; Supports repeatable; tiers added.
Rise of the Abyssals introduced Abyssal content that later fed the 0.4.0 Abyss-core promotion.
Broad character balance pass touching most skills and ascendancies.
Essence, Atlas, Endgame, Item and Skill systems all adjusted; Tablet rework followed in 0.3.1.

sections.title: Campaign impact
sections.oldText: Finish Acts 1-3, then replay the story on Cruel Difficulty to keep levelling.
sections.newText: Acts 1-3 lead into Act 4; Cruel is gone; three Interludes carry you to Level 65 before Endgame.

changes.title: Removed one-per-character limit
changes.detail: A Support could previously be socketed only once per character. 0.3.0 removed that restriction.

changes.title: Supports can repeat
changes.detail: The same Support can now appear in multiple links on one character.

changes.title: Support tiers
changes.detail: Multiple Supports gained an additional tier, expanding scaling options.

changes.title: 11 new Supports
changes.detail: A batch of new Supports was added, several tied to the reworked systems.

cards.detail: Rise of the Abyssals brought Abyssal encounters that 0.4.0 later promoted to core.
The 0.4.0 Abyss-core promotion traces back to this league.

changes.title: Essence changes
changes.detail: Essence acquisition and use were adjusted as part of the crafting pass.

changes.title: Atlas adjustments
changes.detail: Atlas progression and rewards were re-tuned.

changes.title: New Currency, Omens, Uniques, Maps
changes.detail: 0.3.0 shipped new currency, Omens, Uniques and map types.

changes.title: Endgame system changes
changes.detail: Broad Endgame adjustments; the Tablet system was reworked again in 0.3.1.

rows.thenText: Pre-0.3.0: replay on Cruel Difficulty after Acts 1-3.
rows.nowText: 0.3.0+: Act 4 + three Interludes to Level 65, no Cruel.

rows.thenText: Pre-0.3.0: each Support usable only once per character.
Pre-0.3.0: no Rise of the Abyssals league.
rows.nowText: 0.3.0+: league launched; 0.4.0 promoted Abyss to core.

items.label: Unlearn Cruel Difficulty
items.detail: Cruel was removed in 0.3.0. Any guide telling you to 'run Cruel' is obsolete; use Act 4 + Interludes instead.

items.label: Re-plan Support links
items.detail: The one-per-character Support limit is gone; old 'only one of this Support' layouts under-use links.

items.label: Expect a re-tuned campaign to L65
items.detail: Three Interludes now bridge Acts to Level 65; leveling routes changed.

items.label: Re-check Endgame after 0.3.1
items.detail: Tablet/Atlas rules were reworked again in 0.3.1; don't stop at 0.3.0 claims.

rows.currentSummary: The 0.3.0 campaign structure (Act 4, no Cruel, three Interludes to L65) remains in 0.5.4e.
Removed in 0.3.0; Supports are repeatable in 0.5.4e with tiers.
The league ran in 0.3.0; its Abyssal content was promoted to core in 0.4.0.
0.3.0 Endgame changes were refined by the 0.3.1 Tablet rework.

entries.label: 0.3.0 The Third Edict — overview
entries.takeaway: 0.3.0 reveal; note Cruel removal and Support overhaul, which are still current.

items.question: Is Cruel Difficulty still in the game?
answer: No cruel was removed in 0.3.0 the campaign now goes acts 1 3 act 4 three interludes to level 65

items.question: Can I use the same Support in multiple links now?
answer: Yes 0.3.0 removed the one per character limit supports are repeatable and several have added tiers

items.question: What happened to Rise of the Abyssals?
answer: It was the 0.3.0 league its abyssal content was promoted to core in 0.4.0 so abyss now appears in regular maps
